whenToUse: Bulk or trade prices that drop at set quantities (cases, boxes, seats, labels) and the buyer should see which tier they are in.
Nudging to the next price break with how many more units it takes and the saving.
avoidWhen: Plans or packages compared side by side — use pricing-table.
A full quote with many lines, shipping and tax — use line-items or cart-01 and show each line's tier with tierQuote.
a11y: The table has a caption and header cells; the active tier has aria-current and a "Your price" tag in text.
The next-break hint is a polite live region; ladder steps are buttons named "Order 50 at $40.00 per case".
